lessons.title: A New Job Offer
lessons.context: A short story about a difficult career decision.

paragraphs.es: Carlos ha trabajado en la misma empresa durante ocho años.
paragraphs.en: Carlos has worked at the same company for eight years.

paragraphs.es: La semana pasada le ofrecieron un puesto en otra ciudad, con mejor salario.
paragraphs.en: Last week they offered him a position in another city, with a better salary.

paragraphs.es: No está seguro de que sea buena idea dejar a sus amigos y su rutina.
paragraphs.en: He's not sure it's a good idea to leave his friends and his routine.

paragraphs.es: Su esposa le dijo que es importante que piense en su futuro, no solo en el presente.
paragraphs.en: His wife told him it's important that he think about his future, not just the present.

paragraphs.es: Todavía no ha decidido qué hacer, pero tiene que responder para el viernes.
paragraphs.en: He still hasn't decided what to do, but he has to respond by Friday.

questions.question: How long has Carlos worked at his company?
What did they offer him last week?
options: A promotion at the same office

questions.question: Why is Carlos unsure?
options: He would have to leave his friends and routine
He doesn't like the new city

questions.question: By when does he need to respond?

lessons.title: The Neighborhood That Changed
lessons.context: A reflective story using the past perfect to describe change.

paragraphs.es: Cuando Ana volvió a su antiguo barrio, casi no lo reconoció.
paragraphs.en: When Ana returned to her old neighborhood, she almost didn't recognize it.

paragraphs.es: Habían construido varios edificios nuevos donde antes había casas pequeñas.
paragraphs.en: They had built several new buildings where there used to be small houses.

paragraphs.es: La tienda donde compraba dulces de niña ya había cerrado hace años.
paragraphs.en: The store where she used to buy candy as a child had already closed years ago.

paragraphs.es: Sin embargo, el parque donde jugaba seguía siendo exactamente igual.
paragraphs.en: However, the park where she used to play was still exactly the same.

paragraphs.es: Se sentó en un banco y recordó todo lo que había vivido allí.
paragraphs.en: She sat on a bench and remembered everything she had experienced there.

questions.question: What happened when Ana returned to her neighborhood?
What had they built?
What had already closed?
options: The store where she bought candy

questions.question: What stayed the same?
options: The park where she used to play

lessons.title: Advice for a Younger Sibling
lessons.context: A short dialogue-style story built around the subjunctive.

paragraphs.es: Mi hermano menor va a empezar la universidad este año.
paragraphs.en: My younger brother is going to start college this year.

paragraphs.es: Le dije que es importante que organice bien su tiempo desde el principio.
paragraphs.en: I told him it's important that he organize his time well from the start.

paragraphs.es: También le sugerí que hable con sus profesores si tiene dudas.
paragraphs.en: I also suggested that he talk to his professors if he has questions.

paragraphs.es: Espero que haga nuevos amigos y que disfrute esta nueva etapa.
paragraphs.en: I hope he makes new friends and enjoys this new stage.

paragraphs.es: Sé que va a tener éxito porque siempre ha sido muy responsable.
paragraphs.en: I know he's going to succeed because he has always been very responsible.

questions.question: What is the younger brother about to start?
What did the writer say is important?
What did the writer suggest?
options: Talking to professors if he has questions

questions.question: Why does the writer believe he'll succeed?
options: He has always been very responsible
He has a lot of money

lessons.title: A Gift for a Friend
lessons.context: A short story using por and para naturally.

paragraphs.es: Compré este libro para mi amiga Elena por su cumpleaños.
paragraphs.en: I bought this book for my friend Elena for her birthday.

paragraphs.es: Pagué mucho por él porque es una edición especial que ella quería.
paragraphs.en: I paid a lot for it because it's a special edition she wanted.

paragraphs.es: Lo envolví con cuidado y escribí una tarjeta para ella.
paragraphs.en: I wrapped it carefully and wrote a card for her.

paragraphs.es: Voy a pasar por su casa esta tarde para dárselo en persona.
paragraphs.en: I'm going to stop by her house this afternoon to give it to her in person.

paragraphs.es: Sé que le va a encantar, porque hemos sido amigas por más de veinte años.
paragraphs.en: I know she's going to love it, because we've been friends for more than twenty years.

questions.question: Who is the book for?
Why did the writer pay a lot for it?
options: It's a special edition she wanted
It was the only book available

questions.question: What is the writer going to do this afternoon?
options: Stop by Elena's house to give it in person

questions.question: How long have they been friends?

lessons.title: The Best Teacher I've Had
lessons.titleNative: El mejor profesor que he tenido
lessons.context: A reflective story combining present perfect and relative clauses.

paragraphs.es: De todos los profesores que he tenido, el señor Ramírez fue el mejor.
paragraphs.en: Of all the teachers I've had, Mr. Ramírez was the best.

paragraphs.es: Era un hombre que siempre explicaba las cosas con mucha paciencia.
paragraphs.en: He was a man who always explained things with a lot of patience.

paragraphs.es: Nunca he olvidado la forma en que nos enseñó a pensar por nosotros mismos.
paragraphs.en: I've never forgotten the way he taught us to think for ourselves.

paragraphs.es: Los estudiantes que tuvieron la suerte de estar en su clase lo recuerdan con cariño.
paragraphs.en: The students who had the luck of being in his class remember him fondly.

paragraphs.es: Espero que algún día pueda agradecerle todo lo que hizo por mí.
paragraphs.en: I hope that someday I can thank him for everything he did for me.

questions.question: Who was the best teacher the writer has had?
How did Mr. Ramírez explain things?
What did he teach the students to do?
What does the writer hope to do someday?
options: Thank him for everything he did

lessons.title: Preparing for a Job Interview
lessons.titleNative: Prepararse para una entrevista de trabajo
lessons.context: A short story about interview preparation.

paragraphs.es: Mañana tengo una entrevista para el trabajo que siempre había querido.
paragraphs.en: Tomorrow I have an interview for the job I had always wanted.

paragraphs.es: Es necesario que llegue temprano y que lleve todos mis documentos.
paragraphs.en: It's necessary that I arrive early and bring all my documents.

paragraphs.es: Un amigo que trabaja en la misma industria me dio varios consejos útiles.
paragraphs.en: A friend who works in the same industry gave me several useful tips.

paragraphs.es: He practicado mis respuestas frente al espejo durante toda la semana.
paragraphs.en: I've practiced my answers in front of the mirror all week.

paragraphs.es: Estoy nervioso, pero también emocionado por esta oportunidad.
paragraphs.en: I'm nervous, but also excited about this opportunity.

questions.question: What does the writer have tomorrow?
What is necessary according to the writer?
options: Arriving early and bringing all documents

questions.question: Who gave the writer advice?
options: A friend who works in the same industry

questions.question: How does the writer feel?

lessons.title: A Weekend in the Mountains
lessons.titleNative: Un fin de semana en las montañas
lessons.context: A story about a weekend trip, mixing past tenses.

paragraphs.es: El fin de semana pasado fuimos a las montañas, un lugar que nunca habíamos visitado.
paragraphs.en: Last weekend we went to the mountains, a place we had never visited.

paragraphs.es: Cuando llegamos, ya había empezado a nevar un poco.
paragraphs.en: When we arrived, it had already started to snow a little.

paragraphs.es: Caminamos por senderos que ofrecían vistas increíbles del valle.
paragraphs.en: We walked along trails that offered incredible views of the valley.

paragraphs.es: Por la noche, nos sentamos junto al fuego para calentarnos.
paragraphs.en: At night, we sat by the fire to warm up.

paragraphs.es: Ha sido uno de los viajes más relajantes que hemos hecho en años.
paragraphs.en: It has been one of the most relaxing trips we've taken in years.

questions.question: Had they visited the mountains before?
What had already started when they arrived?
What did the trails offer?
How does the writer describe the trip?
options: One of the most relaxing trips in years

lessons.title: Volunteering at the Shelter
lessons.context: A story about community service, using the subjunctive and present perfect.

paragraphs.es: Desde hace un año, he trabajado como voluntaria en un refugio de animales.
paragraphs.en: For a year now, I've worked as a volunteer at an animal shelter.

paragraphs.es: El refugio necesita que más personas adopten a los animales que rescatan.
paragraphs.en: The shelter needs more people to adopt the animals they rescue.

paragraphs.es: Cada perro y gato que llega tiene una historia diferente y difícil.
paragraphs.en: Each dog and cat that arrives has a different, difficult story.

paragraphs.es: Me alegra que cada vez más familias decidan adoptar en lugar de comprar.
paragraphs.en: I'm glad that more and more families are deciding to adopt instead of buy.

paragraphs.es: Este trabajo me ha enseñado el valor de la paciencia y la compasión.
paragraphs.en: This work has taught me the value of patience and compassion.

questions.question: How long has the writer volunteered at the shelter?
What does the shelter need?
What is the writer glad about?
options: More families choosing to adopt instead of buy

questions.question: What has this work taught the writer?
options: The value of patience and compassion

lessons.title: The Letter I Never Sent
lessons.context: A reflective, slightly emotional story about regret and relative clauses.

paragraphs.es: Hace años escribí una carta para una persona a quien nunca le dije la verdad.
paragraphs.en: Years ago I wrote a letter for a person to whom I never told the truth.

paragraphs.es: En ella explicaba todo lo que había sentido pero nunca había expresado en voz alta.
paragraphs.en: In it I explained everything I had felt but had never expressed out loud.

paragraphs.es: Al final, decidí no enviarla porque tenía miedo de su reacción.
paragraphs.en: In the end, I decided not to send it because I was afraid of her reaction.

paragraphs.es: Ahora que ha pasado tanto tiempo, a veces me pregunto qué habría pasado.
paragraphs.en: Now that so much time has passed, sometimes I wonder what would have happened.

paragraphs.es: Es probable que nunca sepa la respuesta, pero al menos aprendí a ser más honesto.
paragraphs.en: It's likely I'll never know the answer, but at least I learned to be more honest.

questions.question: What did the writer never do?
Why didn't the writer send the letter?
What does the writer wonder now?
What did the writer learn from this experience?

lessons.title: Looking Back on the Year
lessons.context: A capstone reflective story reviewing B1's key grammar in context.

paragraphs.es: Este año ha sido lleno de cambios que nunca había imaginado.
paragraphs.en: This year has been full of changes I had never imagined.

paragraphs.es: He aprendido a confiar más en las personas que realmente me apoyan.
paragraphs.en: I've learned to trust more in the people who truly support me.

paragraphs.es: Espero que el próximo año traiga tantas sorpresas buenas como este.
paragraphs.en: I hope next year brings as many good surprises as this one.

paragraphs.es: La ciudad donde vivo ahora se ha convertido en un verdadero hogar para mí.
paragraphs.en: The city where I now live has become a true home for me.

paragraphs.es: Al mirar atrás, me doy cuenta de que cada desafío me ha hecho más fuerte.
paragraphs.en: Looking back, I realize that every challenge has made me stronger.

questions.question: How does the writer describe this year?
What has the writer learned to do?
options: Trust more in people who truly support them

questions.question: What has the city where they live become?
What realization does the writer have looking back?
options: Every challenge has made them stronger
